Tentacruel uses the switches and passive turns it creates to boost, then threatens with physical Sludge Bomb while Hydro Pump or Surf punishes the Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type answers that would otherwise exploit Poison STAB. The second route is a more standard utility/offensive Tentacruel that leans on its Speed, special bulk, Water STAB, status, and coverage.
